facts.claim: When a service has a major problem, a consumer can choose to: cancel the contract and get a refund. This may not be a full refund, as the consumer needs to pay a reasonable amount for any work done so far and as expected, or keep the contract, but pay a lower price that takes the problem into account.
facts.use_note: General consumer guarantees for services, not wedding-specific. Applies to Australian suppliers under the ACL; overseas venues may not be covered (not confirmed).

facts.claim: Businesses can't take away a consumer's right to a refund or replacement for faulty products or services. It's illegal for businesses to rely on store policies or terms and conditions which deny these rights. Consumers are not entitled to a repair, replacement or refund under the consumer guarantees if they ... simply changed their mind.
facts.use_note: Change of mind: a couple who cancels by choice relies on the venue contract terms. Supports a 'cancellation and deposit terms' column.

facts.claim: Under the Australian Consumer Law, businesses must not accept payment for products or services if: they don't intend to supply the product or service; they intend to supply different products or services from those promised; they know, or should know, that they won't be able to supply the products or services by the promised date, or within a reasonable time.
facts.use_note: Deposits paid far in advance.

facts.claim: Businesses do not have to give replacement services or refunds under the consumer guarantees if the actions of a third party prevented them from supplying their services. ... In this situation, consumers' right to a refund or replacement will generally depend on the terms and conditions of the agreement for supply of the service.
facts.use_note: Supports a 'postponement and force majeure terms' row. Not legal advice; say so.

facts.claim: Tuscany: exclusive hire for 60 to 80 guests across three nights typically starts at around €27,000 to €30,000 in 2026. One Lake Garda villa offers a 2026 two-night exclusive package from €24,000 to €30,000, depending on the month.
facts.use_note: Venue hire only, not totals. EUR, 2026. Extractor wording; confirm on page.

facts.claim: Some luxury spaces set a minimum spend, from AED 60,000 at a desert resort to AED 120,000 for an outdoor amphitheatre. Ask whether a quoted rate includes the 7% municipality fee, 10% service charge and 5% VAT.
facts.use_note: Minimum spend example for a spreadsheet column. AED. Packages valid until 30 December 2026.

facts.claim: A welcome aperitivo and a farewell lunch can add 25–40% on top of the wedding-day total. Italian VAT is 22% on most services, so check whether each quote includes it.
facts.use_note: VAT from own page only; no official Italian tax source. Writer replaces range dash with 'to'.

facts.claim: Guest flights, guest accommodation, 22 percent VAT and supplier travel usually sit outside quoted budgets. Hold back 8 to 10 percent for the unexpected. VAT is 22 percent on most services and 10 percent on hotel stays and restaurant meals.
facts.use_note: Supports 'tax included?' and 'contingency' columns. Italy only.

facts.claim: Venue (€10,000–€60,000+). Catering and drinks (€250–€450 per guest). A midweek or shoulder-season date, or a smaller guest list, can cut the total by 20–30%.
facts.use_note: 60-guest Lake Como; SITE-CONFLICT-03 with /real-weddings/lake-como-wedding-cost. Use for structure (venue vs per-guest catering), not as a benchmark. EUR.

facts.claim: Guest accommodation = 'Paid separately, usually at negotiated group rates'; Legal and documentation = 'Paid separately, destination-dependent'; Ceremony venue and styling, Dedicated planner and concierge, The couple's accommodation = 'Included in every package'.
facts.use_note: Room blocks: guest rooms sit outside package price. Pair with 'Specific inclusions vary by resort'.

facts.claim: Nirjhara noise and house rules: 'Music must end by 10 PM for non-buyout events. No music curfew applies with an exclusive resort buyout.' 'Outside food and drinks are not permitted; exceptions for food require prior approval.' 'Fireworks require hotel approval and valid police and village permits.' 'An IDR 10,000,000 security deposit is required per event, refundable after any applicable deductions.' 'Ceremony and dinner venues depend on weather and guest numbers.'
facts.use_note: Best worked example of curfew, buyout, security deposit, outside catering and wet-weather columns. Venue rule, not law. IDR deposit: Nic sign-off.

facts.claim: Resort Exclusivity offer: 'Up to 60 guests. Two-night buyout of all 25 units, up to 2-day venue use, flowers and reception lighting ...', USD 28,000.00 starting from. Capacity 150 seated overall; The Garden 100 seated / 150 standing; Ambu 65 seated / 80 standing; Lounge 50 seated / 65 standing.
facts.use_note: Shows why capacity must be compared per space (seated vs standing) and why a buyout guest cap (60) can be lower than seated capacity (150). USD.

facts.claim: 'by the time catering, hire, power, staffing and wet-weather cover are priced in, the villa's freedom is usually a premium, not a saving.' Questions to ask include 'What exactly is exclusive to us: which spaces, for which hours, and who else is on the property that day?' and 'What are the noise, curfew and amplified-music rules, and are they council-imposed or negotiable?'
facts.use_note: Own venue questions; link, do not repeat wholesale. Cannibalisation check: this page already has a questions-to-ask list.

facts.claim: Our 2026 cost guide: hidden costs include banjar (local community) fees, generator hire, overtime, corkage, wet weather marquees, government taxes and service charges. Suppliers usually take 30-50% deposit, balance 30-60 days before. Premium venues book out 12-18 months ahead.
facts.use_note: Bali only. Deposit percentages are planner practice, not law. Good list of hidden-cost columns.

facts.claim: Smartraveller Indonesia: weather conditions can change quickly during the wet season, usually around October to April; flooding, landslides and mudslides occur regularly during the wet season.
facts.use_note: Supports a 'wet-weather plan' column for Bali venues.

facts.claim: Ask the hotel in writing for rigging points and the weight each holds, fabric fire ratings, load-in hours, and whether an outside decorator pays a fee or works beside the in-house team.
facts.use_note: Venue questions: load-in hours, outside supplier fees.

facts.claim: Is open flame allowed, allowed only when enclosed, or not allowed at all? ... Can anything be fixed to beams, walls, the ceiling or marquee poles? ... Some hotels and country houses ban naked flame outright, so get every answer in writing before you brief the florist.
facts.use_note: Venue rules column (flame, fixings). 'Get it in writing' principle.

facts.claim: Portable generators should never be used indoors or in enclosed areas. They emit carbon monoxide that you cannot see or smell ... Only use heavy-duty extension cords that are in good condition and rated in watts or amps at least equal to the rating of the generator.
facts.use_note: Household guidance; use only to justify a 'power supply / generator needed?' column for estates and villas. Victoria.

facts.claim: Wedded Wonderland's vendor search page (heading 'Trusted Vendors') shows '231 vendors available' with category tabs: All, Beauty & Wellness, Cakes, Caterers, Celebrant, Content Creation, Decor & Floral Artistry, Design, Entertainment, Fashion & Bridal Couture, Florists, Hair & Makeup artist, Lifestyle & Jewellery, Photographer & Video, Specialty Services, Style & Decor, Travel & Hospitality, Wedding & Event Planner, Wedding Dress Designer, Wedding Stationery & Website; plus a 'Filters' control. Intro: 'Planners, photographers, florists and stylists — the quiet professionals shaping the world's most elegant weddings.'
facts.use_note: LIVE (200). It lists vendors, NOT venues; no 'Venues' category in the vendor tab. Contents of 'Filters' not visible in the scrape. Intro contains an em dash: do not quote it. Some cards show 'Wedded Perks'. Use as the vendor-shortlist link, not a venue-comparison link.

facts.claim: Wonderland Studio: 'Free to use · no credit card · no trial clock'. 'Eleven tools, one login'. 'Stop copying details between spreadsheets, group chats and notes apps. Everything lives together, and it all stays in sync.' 'Vendors you can trust: Shortlist from our vetted network and keep every booking in one place.' FAQ: 'Every couple gets the full planning suite (website builder with RSVP, guest list, budget tracker, timeline, task list, seating, menu, calendar, decor moodboard and vendor management), trusted venue and vendor recommendations, and an AI Planning Assistant'. Budget tool: 'Set a budget, log deposits and see what is left in every category.'
facts.use_note: LIVE. Studio has a vendor shortlist ('Shortlist from our vetted network', demo includes 'Cliffside Estate, Venue, Santorini') and vendor management. NO dedicated venue comparison or side-by-side scoring feature is described. Do not claim one. AI assistant demo answer ('Most couples put 45 to 50% into venue and catering') is a UI mock, not a sourced statistic: do not cite.

facts.claim: 'When a venue or vendor sends you an invoice or a payment link, you pay it securely through Wedded Wonderland, and your payments sit in your planning hub beside the rest of your plans.' 'Deposits, balances and bookings sit together under Payments in your planning hub'. 'The Wedded Wonderland team then liaises with your vendor and will be in touch with next steps - paying does not by itself confirm a booking.' 'If the charge is in a currency other than your card's, your bank or card provider may add its own foreign-transaction charge.'
facts.use_note: Relevant to deposit tracking. Keep the 'does not by itself confirm a booking' caveat if mentioned. Source uses a spaced hyphen, not an em dash.

facts.claim: Planners compare packages by normalising them, and you can run the same method in an afternoon with a spreadsheet. It has 4 steps. 1. Build the inclusion checklist first. List every element your wedding needs (spaces, menu tier, beverage hours, coordinator, photography hours, florals, music, cake, transport, and your non-negotiables), then mark each package's coverage: included, upgrade, or excluded. 2. Price the gaps. ... 3. Compute true per-guest cost. (Package price + mandatory taxes and charges + your priced gaps) divided by your realistic guest count. Run it at your optimistic and conservative RSVP numbers ... 4. Stress-test the contract levers. What happens to the price if 10 guests drop? Where do the minimums sit? What is the overtime rate, the weather back-up, the deposit and refund ladder? Two packages with identical true per-guest costs can carry completely different risk.
facts.use_note: Published 2026-08-11, modified 2026-09-30. CANNIBALISATION RISK: this page already teaches a venue-package comparison spreadsheet method. Link to it and build on it (venue-level columns, destination factors), do not repeat. Extractor wording; writer confirms the exact sentence. Page also cites US package figures (from US sources); do not reuse those.

facts.claim: 'Think about ceremony and reception flow, guest experience, weather back-up plans, and how much styling you'd like to add versus venues that feel "ready" as is. Use our filters to narrow by guest count and location, then enquire with 3–5 favourites to compare packages and availability.' Start-your-search guest bands: 'Any size, Up to 80, 80 – 150, 150 – 250, 250+ guests'. 'You'll be taken to our full search experience where you can refine by style, amenities, and more.' FAQ: 'Start by browsing venues by location and style, then use filters for guest count, budget, and ceremony or reception needs. Shortlist your favourites and send enquiries directly to confirm availability and pricing.'
facts.use_note: LIVE (200), heading 'Where Your Wedding Begins'. City pages listed: Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, Sydney. Venue filters are on /search?tab=venues (not ?tab=vendors). Page says 'Page 1 of 2'; sitemap says 'All Wedding Venues (78)'; an extractor said 93. Do not state a venue count. Range dashes in quote: writer uses 'to'.

facts.claim: 'A spreadsheet or Notion template is free, endlessly flexible and perfectly good for a small, simple wedding.' 'Wonderland Studio is our pick: eleven connected tools in one account, with a 7-day free trial and CSV exports so you never lose your spreadsheet habit.' 'In Studio, if a trial or subscription lapses, nothing is deleted, but the dashboard locks until you subscribe.' 'You can export guests, RSVPs (with meals and plus-ones) and the seating Master List as CSV whenever you like.'
facts.use_note: Published 2026-10-09, modified 2026-10-27. SITE-CONFLICT-STUDIO: this page says '7-day free trial' and 'dashboard locks until you subscribe'; /wonderland-studio (F-20) says 'Free to use · no credit card · no trial clock'. Use the Studio page wording; do not mention a trial until Nic resolves. CSV export is for guests, RSVPs and seating only: no venue comparison export stated.
